strongest_angle: Examine the 2021 Meltwater Champions Chess Tour Finals game between Teimour Radjabov and Hikaru Nakamura, focusing on the critical blunder where Radjabov had only six seconds left on the clock.

key_facts.fact: During the Meltwater Champions Chess Tour Finals in 2021, grandmaster Teimour Radjabov had only six seconds to choose his move against Hikaru Nakamura.
In round six of the 2021 Meltwater Champions Chess Tour Finals, grandmaster Teimour Radjabov won a 3-1 match against grandmaster Wesley So.
During round 2.5 of the Meltwater Tour Final in 2021, grandmaster Teimour Radjabov faced grandmaster Hikaru Nakamura using the Queen's Gambit Declined Three Knights Variation.
